title: Say how we choose version numbers
statement: As a developer, I can write down our versioning scheme in the template, so whoever creates a release knows what number to give it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The template accepts any written scheme, whether semantic, incremental or anything else, and shows it on the Release Template page.
`release create` prints the scheme when it is asked for help or refuses for a missing version.
A version that does not fit the written scheme is accepted.
